parameters.name: CampaignName
parameters.description: Name of the associated operational activity.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number of the training job list. Starts from 1. Default value is 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of training jobs to display per page in a paged query. Default value is 10.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description:
Filter by training job status. Valid values:
- 0: In queue.
- 1: Submitted.
- 2: Running.
- 3: Succeeded.
- 4: Failed.
